explain.ko: 현재완료(have / has + 과거분사)는 과거와 지금을 이어 줍니다. 지금까지 계속되는 상태(for / since), 경험(ever / never), 지금도 남아 있는 결과에 씁니다. 과거의 끝난 시점(last year, in 2019, yesterday)과는 쓰지 않고 과거형을 씁니다. for 뒤에는 기간(five years), since 뒤에는 시작 시점(2018)이 옵니다. just / already는 have 뒤, yet은 문장 끝에 둡니다.
explain.en: The present perfect (have / has + past participle) links the past to now. Use it for situations that continue until now (for / since), for experiences (ever / never), and for past actions with a result that matters now. Do not use it with a finished time (last year, in 2019, yesterday); use the past simple. 'For' is followed by a length of time (five years) and 'since' by a starting point (2018). Put 'just' and 'already' after have / has, and 'yet' at the end.

rows: I've lived here for six years.

notes.ko: for = 기간(for three years), since = 시작 시점(since 2019).
notes.en: for = a length of time (for three years), since = a starting point (since 2019).

notes.ko: have been to = 갔다 온 적이 있다, have gone to = 가 버려서 지금 여기 없다.
notes.en: have been to = visited and came back; have gone to = is there now.

notes.ko: yesterday, last week, in 2019, ago와는 현재완료를 쓰지 않습니다.
notes.en: Do not use the present perfect with yesterday, last week, in 2019 or ago.

prompt.ko: 자신의 경험을 3문장으로 써 보세요: 가 본 곳, 얼마나 오래 살았거나 일했는지, 아직 못 해 본 일.
prompt.en: Write 3 sentences about your life so far: a place you have been to, how long you have lived or worked somewhere, and something you haven't done yet.
